messages:
Maya (People Ops): Follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A re: the headcount heatmap, sprint hiring week, and the new manager hiring-credit idea. Capturing answers here for managers. Drop other Qs.

Jonas (CTO): High level: this quarter we shift ~40 hires toward infra, platform automation, and core reliability. Net +38 headcount target. We're introducing a small pool for cross-team migration projects and experimenting with a manager hiring-credit system (details below).

Sahil (VP Eng): Banding note: we did a comp/bands audit. Bars unchanged functionally, but interview expectations for senior ICs clarified (systems/ownership + mentoring). All infra reqs should include a "scale-scenario" interview item.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Sourcing plan: sprint hiring week starts Mon week-after-next. Well batch-screen and calendar-block interview lanes. Please add the diversity-slate tag and the hiring-credit tag to GH reqs where applicable.

Asha (ENG Manager - Runtime): Question: what are hiring credits? If I have 2 credits can I convert one to an FTE later?

Maya (People Ops): Hiring credits are a short-term experiment: managers get credits that let them reserve 1 interview lane (priority scheduling) or convert to a pooled slot approval within 10 business days. Credits do not create new headcount; they only speed scheduling/placement. Conversions to permanent team slots require the normal approval flow.

Priya (Finance): Finance note: credits don't change budget. If a conversion increases comp >10% we need a quick budget review. We'll keep an audit log of credit usage.

Sahil (VP Eng): Process clarification: pooled slots (POOL_INFRA) let teams recommend hires; central ops will confirm placement within 7 business days. If you need to keep a pooled slot on your team, submit a 2-sentence case to People Ops + Eng leadership.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Interview ops: for sprint week, please pre-fill panel members and availability. Well run calibration sessions Thurs 11am PT for scoring alignment. Also, add the new scorecard item "systems thinking for scale" for infra roles.

Asha (ENG Manager - Runtime): On internal mobility: someone on my team is ready for an L3 -> L4 move. Does that consume a slot?

Maya (People Ops): Internal rebanding: if total headcount stays the same, you don't need a new slot. If the reband increases comp budget materially (>10%), tag @Priya. For moves >=2 bands, open a req. Include a 2-bullet growth plan in the form.

Jonas (CTO): Messaging pointers for external partners: call this a "targeted Q3 capacity build  infra & platform". Avoid "reorg" or "mass hiring". Keep public language measured.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Candidate experience: well offer 48-72 hour loop scheduling windows during sprint week. If teams need faster offers, use the "expedite" label and @Maya will route approvals.

Priya (Finance): Relocation/comp exceptions: still possible but limited. Route exceptions with a 1-paragraph ROI note. We'll turn around standard cases in 3 business days.

Maya (People Ops): Onboarding snapshot (will post full doc in handbook): Week1: access & buddy; Week2: small pairing task; Weeks3-6: system deep dives; Weeks7-12: deliverable + 90-day goals. I'll upload the full checklist and the heatmap visual to the handbook by EOD tomorrow.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-heatmap-and-credits (doc id: 1127)

Asha (ENG Manager - Runtime): Thanks  will flag my internal promotion and set up panels for sprint week.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Thanks everyone  will share the sprint calendar and the GH template updates later today.

Maya (People Ops): I'll close the loop with a one-pager: headcount map, credits FAQ, pooling tags, onboarding link. DM me for any urgent approvals. :sparkles:
